title: You Get Me So High
lyrics:
[00:11.56]Hope you don't regret it
[00:13.13]I pushed a lot back, but I can't forget it
[00:16.86]We never got the credit
[00:18.91]Nobody seemed to hear us, but we said it
[00:22.46]Neither of us planned it
[00:24.07]And for a long time, I took it all for granted
[00:27.79]I really thought we had it
[00:29.49]But at the time, it was more than I could manage, so
[00:33.73]If we can leave it all behind us
[00:39.18]And meet in between
[00:42.42]It would get me so
[00:44.94]High all the time, high all the time
[00:48.34]I wanna be high all the time
[00:52.47]Would you come with me?
[00:55.20]Wish I didn't doubt it
[00:56.77]I wish I never, ever told you all about it
[01:00.48]But I just had to let you know
[01:02.54]I never meant to hurt you, though
[01:06.08]I had all my motives
[01:07.68]I didn't know they wouldn't mix with your emotions
[01:11.57]I just had to reach my goals
[01:13.63]Never knew I'd meet you though, so
[01:17.38]If we can agree to disagree
[01:21.69]And keep on reaching
[01:26.08]It would get you so
[01:28.57]High all the time, high all the time
[01:31.92]I wanna be high all the time
[01:36.15]Would you come with me?
[01:39.53]High all the time, high all the time
[01:42.80]I wanna be high all the time
[01:47.07]Would you come with me?
[01:49.75]We should stick together
[01:51.47]You're my best friend, I'll love you forever
[01:57.94]Would you come with me?
[02:00.69]We could be the greatest
[02:02.20]It doesn't matter if we're never rich or famous
[02:08.87]Would you come with me?
[02:12.25]High all the time, high all the time
[02:15.51]I wanna be high all the time
[02:19.73]Would you come with me?
[02:22.87]If you can just let me know if it's okay
[02:28.28]To call you when I'm lonely
